summary: val-pilot-gate design memo v0.2 committed (3d8e5b2) at automation/designs/VAL_PILOT_GATE_DESIGN.md. User-calibrated verdict scheme: STRONG-GO (complete pilot; val PGD Rfall@FAR<=0.10 >= 0.70; AUROC >= 0.90; clean recall degradation <= 5pp; human approval still required before any frozen protocol) / REVIEW-GO (Rfall band [0.50,0.70) OR AUROC band [0.88,0.90); novel or improves low-FAR; requires >=1 additional validation seed) / NO-GO (integrity contamination, missing metadata, checkpoint mismatch, wrong split; or AUROC clearly < 0.88 without low-FAR improvement; or dominated) / NEEDS-REVIEW (default bucket for anything matching no category). Three accepted edge-case defaults recorded in memo section 5.4. Design only: no implementation, no receipts directory, no scanner, no guard integration, no blocking.
